query:
WITH driver_ages AS (
  SELECT 
    t.control_number,
    t.sequence_number,
    t.violator_id,
    YEAR(t.gdate_happened) AS violation_year,
    CASE 
      WHEN (YEAR(t.gdate_happened) - YEAR(d.birth_date)) < 25 THEN 'under_25'
      ELSE 'over_25'
    END AS age_group
  FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation t
  JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON CAST(t.violator_id AS BIGINT) = d.id
  WHERE YEAR(t.gdate_happened) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
    AND d.birth_date IS NOT NULL
),

annual_violations AS (
  SELECT 
    age_group,
    violation_year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_violations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS unique_drivers
  FROM driver_ages
  GROUP BY age_group, violation_year
),

avg_violations_per_driver AS (
  SELECT 
    age_group,
    violation_year,
    total_violations / unique_drivers AS avg_violations_per_driver
  FROM annual_violations
)

SELECT 
  violation_year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) AS under_25_avg,
  MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) AS over_25_avg,
  ROUND(
    (
      MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) - 
      MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END)
    ) * 100 / 
    MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END),
    2
  ) AS percentage_difference
FROM avg_violations_per_driver
GROUP BY violation_year
ORDER BY violation_year LIMIT 20000
